title: Who's coming? K-drama, K-pop stars visiting PH this November 2026
summary: Several South Korean stars are set to visit the Philippines in November for concerts and fan meetings, from actors affectionately dubbed 'ahjussi' by fans to musicians spanning a wide range of genres.
